property_summary: After any successful initialize call, the nft address must be set to the provided _nft parameter. The mutant breaks this by unconditionally setting nft to address(0), so after initialization, the nft getter returns a different value than the parameter that was passed.
change_summary: Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(0);` so that nft is always set to the zero address regardless of the parameter.
